# Source-text-only tests, grandfathered.
#
# Every entry below is a test whose assertions only check that a source file
# contains a string. Such a test passes against a broken implementation, so it
# is not regression coverage - it is a spelling check on the code.
#
# THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK.
#   * scripts/check-source-grep-tests.py rejects a pull request that adds an
#     entry, and rejects an entry that no longer matches a source-text-only
#     test (fix the test, then delete its line).
#   * To remove an entry, rewrite the test so it asserts on behaviour: drive the
#     function or state machine and check the value or event it produces. Prove
#     it by reverting the production change and watching the test fail.
#   * Never add an entry to make a new test pass. Write a behavioural test.
#
# Format: <path relative to the repository root>::<test function name>
